title: An Real-Sim-Real (RSR) Loop Framework for Generalizable Robotic Policy Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2503.10118v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The sim-to-real gap remains a critical challenge in robotics, hindering the deployment of algorithms trained in simulation to real-world systems. We propose a flexible Real-to-Sim-to-Real (RSR) framework whose central contribution is an information-theoretic cost function that explicitly accounts for sim-to-real discrepancies. This cost balances two objectives, completing the task and steering the policy to collect real-world samples that are maximally informative for improving transfer. It can be integrated seamlessly into existing reinforcement learning algorithms (e.g., PPO, SAC) and ensures a balanced exploration of critical regions in the real domain. The framework treats differentiable simulation as optional: when a differentiable simulator is available, the collected informative data can also be used to tune simulator parameters. translated_title: 一种用于可泛化机器人策略迁移的实-仿-实（RSR）闭环框架
translated_abstract: 仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距仍然是机器人领域的关键挑战，它阻碍了在仿真环境中训练的算法部署到真实世界系统中。我们提出了一种灵活的实-仿-实（Real-to-Sim-to-Real，RSR）框架，其核心贡献是一个显式考虑仿真到现实差异的信息论代价函数。该代价函数平衡了两个目标：完成任务，以及引导策略收集对改进迁移最具信息量的真实世界样本。它可以无缝集成到现有的强化学习算法（如PPO、SAC）中，并确保对真实域中关键区域的均衡探索。该框架将可微仿真视为可选项：当存在可微仿真器时，收集到的高信息量数据还可用于调整仿真器参数。我们基于MuJoCo MJX平台实现了该框架，并通过实验展示了其通用性。
tldr: 提出了一种以信息论代价函数为核心的实-仿-实（RSR）闭环框架，通过引导策略收集对改进迁移最具信息量的真实世界样本，并无缝集成于现有强化学习算法中，从而弥合仿真到现实的差距。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Real-Sim-Real (RSR) loop framework centered on an information-theoretic cost function that steers policies to collect maximally informative real-world samples, seamlessly integrating into existing reinforcement learning algorithms to bridge the sim-to-real gap.
